set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='ece68658188fd119b937a7a9b5ffd30d856b9aec'; FILE='tools/ui-smoke/run-android-ui-smoke.sh'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --no-tags origin main; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; python3 -c "exec('from pathlib import Path
p=Path("tools/ui-smoke/run-android-ui-smoke.sh")
s=p.read_text()
cal='tap_desc "Calibrate"\nwait_target text "Suspicious"\nshot 05-radar-calibration-menu\ntap_text "Suspicious"\n\n# Open first visible Details action.\n'
end='tap_desc "Refresh focused scan"\nsleep 1\nback\nwait_target content-desc "Menu"\n\n# Add one non-watchlist card, then exercise Watchlist.\n'
assert cal in s
assert end in s
s=s.replace(cal,'# Open first visible Details action.\n',1)
replacement='tap_desc "Refresh focused scan"\nsleep 1\nback\nwait_target content-desc "Menu"\n\n# Classification removes the reviewed card from Radar, so exercise it only after Details.\ntap_desc "Calibrate"\nwait_target text "Suspicious"\nshot 05-radar-calibration-menu\ntap_text "Suspicious"\nwait_target content-desc "Menu"\n\n# Add one non-watchlist card, then exercise Watchlist.\n'
s=s.replace(end,replacement,1)
p.write_text(s)
')"; bash -n "$FILE"; git diff --check; test "$(git diff --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = '1'; test "$(git diff --name-only)" = "$FILE"; grep -q 'Classification removes the reviewed card' "$FILE"; git add "$FILE"; git commit -m 'Exercise Details before destructive calibration in UI smoke'; git push origin HEAD:main; printf 'ui_smoke_reorder_sha=%s
' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
